results.title: Lego Batman - Red Hood's Retribution
results.overview: When Lego Batman's villains keep winding up murdered, The Dark Knight is perplexed because that's usually his job. With his new son Damian suited up as the latest Robin, the two embark on a mission to solve the mystery, get the crown, and save Bikini Bottom.

results.title: Tsugi
results.overview: A mystery thriller that starts with a disappearance but ends with mind bending twists.

results.title: A Shonda
results.overview: “A Shonda” is a short ritual art film filmed in the holy days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. Two transsexual Jews commune with the dead, reimagine gendered cultural practices, and attempt to atone for the sins committed in their name.

results.title: Sienna Spiro: Austin City Limits
results.overview: Breakout British singer-songwriter Sienna Spiro, one of music's most compelling new artists, brings her showstopping vocals and emotionally rich songwriting to a spellbinding ACL debut. She performs highlights from her debut album.

results.title: The Sickling
results.overview: After surviving a lifetime of debilitating pain caused by sickle cell disease, Gabriel Badejo takes the greatest risk of his life by undergoing an experimental stem cell transplant in hopes of a cure. The Sickling follows Gabriel’s emotional and physical journey as he confronts systemic racism in healthcare, painful memories of medical neglect, and the global realities of living with an often invisible disease. From Toronto to Nigeria, the film explores the intersections of illness, identity, family, and survival while uncovering the historical inequities that continue to shape sickle cell care worldwide. At its heart, The Sickling is a deeply personal story about healing, resilience, and the fight to reclaim a future once thought impossible.

results.title: Be My Baby
results.overview: It was only supposed to be a movie night. But the Boyfriend and his adult content creator Girlfriend are still reeling from the aftermath of her miscarriage. Their neighbors, an excitable Husband and his apprehensive Wife, are a few weeks into their first pregnancy. The Husband is eager to share the news, while the Wife wants to keep it quiet. When the two couples get together, the wine flows and what was supposed to be a casual movie night spirals into a devastating game of revelations.

results.title: Sepulchre

results.title: Render
results.overview: Luke takes a new drug called 'RENDER' that gives him intense euphoria while he regularly sees a prostitute that he has an abnormal relationship with. After taking this new drug for a period of time, things start to spiral out of control for Luke.

results.title: Water Body
results.overview: An immersive audiovisual experience using global Earth systems datasets to explore water as the connective tissue of life revealing its continuous movement through rivers, oceans, landscapes and living beings as one planetary circulation.

results.title: The Last Treatment
results.overview: The Last Treatment follows a renowned doctor trapped in a deadly night of crime, fear and impossible choices. As danger closes in, he is forced to fight for survival while facing revenge, sacrifice and painful decisions. Packed with action, suspense and emotional moments, the story explores a father's unstoppable love and the lengths he will go to protect those he cares for.

results.title: Großstadtrevier – Knockout
results.overview: In the third 90-minute episode of the popular early-evening series, the overly conscientious precinct chief, Ms. Küppers (Saskia Fischer), of all people, finds herself the focus of the investigation. After a serious traffic accident, Ms. Küppers’ car is found abandoned at the scene, while a pedestrian is fighting for his life. Has the otherwise conscientious chief actually committed a hit-and-run? Lukas Petersen (Patrick Abozen) can’t believe it and, together with Bente Hinrichs (Sinha Melina Gierke) and the team, begins searching for the truth. The trail leads far beyond the events of the night of the accident, right into a web of lies, power, and violence. And Robert Gebhardt (Oliver Mommsen), a longtime friend of Ms. Küppers, also plays a crucial role in the matter.

results.title: A Letter To Mr. Stapleton
results.overview: An introduction from one party to another.

results.title: Abode of Heaven
results.overview: For the first time in 35 years, musicians set out from the entrance of the Zangezur Corridor toward ancient Ordubad. In neighborhoods that have become part of the region's historical heritage, *Ordubad bayatis* are performed to the accompaniment of authentic music for the first time. Customs and traditions—spanning from the city center to the most remote villages, previously unspoken of and unique to this area—are being brought to life. The musicians' primary mission is to reveal the rhythms of Ordubad—rhythms that have endured for millennia yet remained hidden until now.

results.title: Tulipop: Pumpkin Pip
results.overview: Every year, the colorful inhabitants of Tulipop island celebrate Spookyooky Night by donning exciting costumes and embarking on a “share or scare” adventure!
